environment.configuration: Debug/OFF, GCC with -g1, CLI/layer/tests and SPIR-V validation ON, real runtime layer tests OFF

finding_evidence.R21-U1-COMPATIBILITY: All three old-caller gates passed in the exact Debug/OFF matrix. The CMake script requires the single exact INFO summary with three created and zero unsuccessful/unknown outcomes before removing that precise line from the legacy ERROR|failed|Failed|unsupported scan.
finding_evidence.R21-U1-RETENTION: The ledger owns exactly sized state and hash arrays. At one selection and one worker, the production assertion checks sizeof(ReplayReconciliation) + 28 + sizeof(ProcessProgress), including the owned hash and worker vector capacity. The generated archive excludes over 105,000 keys. Instrumentation observed 21,738,472 tracked large bytes live at peak and zero at the actual worker fork. Each tracked C++ allocation is at least 256 KiB. The 105,000-selected-item stress checks exact 28-byte per-key state with warning emission enabled and disabled.
finding_evidence.R21-U1-SELECTED-PARENT: The Linux scheduler/worker/controller fixtures verify a single parent call at selected index 21 with borrowed resume cursor 1, clean 23 Created, forced parent error 21 Created + 1 CreateFailed + 1 Dependency, and forced foundation error 20 Created + 1 CreateFailed + 2 Dependency. Each has zero unknown and expected native exit. A clean interleaved-context run checks the same replacement in context 1 at stable index 1045. The outside-assignment, cross-worker, and borrowed-crash controls still pass.

summary: Selected nested parent work now publishes the active deferred item’s actual tag/hash/index and terminal status, with the borrowed legacy recovery cursor kept independent. Linux and Windows controllers destroy the discovery and exclusion report before worker launch. The compatibility gate verifies the successful three-item summary and still applies the unchanged legacy diagnostic matcher to all other output.

R21-bounded-state.assertions: 105,000 keys with exact backing-store accounting, deterministic stale/out-of-order duplicates, codec and omission controls, matching distributions with capped warning collection enabled or disabled. Narrow real archive selection checks one stable item, exact owned storage including the worker vector capacity, and zero large preparation allocations still live at the worker fork.

R21-production-ordering.assertions: Real null-device call traces and real controller. Crash at index 10 creates 1..9 and 11..20, retries [11,21), marks 10 skipped and 0 unknown with nonzero status. Dependency crash with borrowed index retries [1,21) without an attributed selected culprit. Paired clean case creates 21 selected and the dependency. Nested replacement attributes actual success and two failure paths at stable selected indices, separate from the borrowed cursor. Controlled failures retain the existing legacy counter.

R21-reconciliation-properties.assertions: 5,040 permutations with four duplicate subsets per permutation, independent terminal oracle, tag/hash/worker/range validation, conflict and stale failure history, and strict codec resynchronization.

R21-regression-sensitivity.assertions: Exact clean control passed. An isolated mutation is an independent checker gate.

R21-retry-and-evidence-loss.assertions: Actual retry ranges and previous terminal failure retained, clean FINAL and native zero require item facts, hard loss/truncation preserves only received facts, full sibling evidence survives either harvest order, setup failure leaves known selection unknown.

R21-selected-boundary-and-outcomes.assertions: Exact per-item creation, read, parse, support, dependency, validation, VkResult and setup outcomes, first-success/later-failure loop, no-execution status, actual compatible hint skip, required incomplete and accepted recovered scope, equal hashes across tags, composite duplicates, extra library role, and ordinary, quiet and progress controller paths.

verification_limits: The implementation worktree verified 320/320 registered Linux Debug/OFF cases against the exact repair candidate.
Exact Release/OFF, Release/ON, ASan+UBSan and mutation runs are coordinator/checker work and this report claims no outcomes for those runs.
Native Windows runtime verification was user-waived. The paired source paths were updated and reviewed.
CPU/null-device fixtures establish no Vulkan hardware, driver cache, persistence or Steam-runtime behavior.
The fork observation tracks live C++ allocations at least 256 KiB. It measures release of discovery-sized buffers and does not measure process RSS, allocator arenas or file-backed metadata.
